runtime: Chromium, document injected with set_content; managed file:// navigation blocked
testScope: Browser UI and export tested. Native unmanaged file:// opening and other browsers are not verified here.

tests.name: Application starts with no errors
No external requests on startup
Initial diagram contains 12 visible objects
Named views change disclosure, modality and viewport
Collapse/expand writes view state into DSL
Real pointer drag round-trips a relative hint
Pin drag persists exact parent-local coordinates
Soft offset does not accumulate on rerender
Container-specific layout changes write a view-local recipe
Incremental add captures explicit stays and adds an edge
Local reflow removes local soft hints and records outside stays
Exact checkpoint round-trip and invalidation
Viewport and modality edits are persisted source
Invalid edits retain last-good diagram and block mutations
Undo/redo restores source authority
Rename preserves stable references
Verify compares complete geometry for 20 fresh compiles
SVG export is standalone, parseable and downloadable
DSL export contains current source verbatim
Project export/import round-trips source and history
Fresh browser context reproduces an edited diagram from DSL alone
User text is escaped in UI and SVG; DSL has no execution primitive
Narrow browser layout has no horizontal page overflow
Final example screenshots and static SVG artifacts
Browser and Node agree exactly on every example/view geometry
No runtime exceptions during integration tests
